_doc: ARDOR dating cabinet (#47, built 2026-07-17-eve; roster #23). Varese family house: 1974 Dorelio Rovera + father Angelo turn the family production artisan — ARDOR = AngeloRovera + DORelio. The Rovera line goes back to Sociedade Rovera 1911 (the ex-Rossi spin-off ecosystem — matches rossi.json's 'Rovera brothers 1911'). Few hard stamp cliffs -> floors + era hints (Giants/Super Giants = Monjure-US era 2000s). SOURCES: staging/pipedia/Ardor.json (company text + Morrison NASPC article).

history_anchors._doc: 1911: Sociedade Rovera founded (Francesco Rovera + brothers; Varese pipe country). Angelo (Francesco's son) -> 1974: ARDOR founded with Dorelio (4th generation later = DAMIANO, who introduced the COLOURED METHACRYLATE stems + modern shapes). Gavirate (VA) — same town as the Paronelli museum (rossi.json ecosystem). US: Steve Monjure (Monjure International) = the distributor era; 'GIANTS' stamp born of the Morrison demand (~2000s), then 'SUPER GIANTS' (old huge blocks found); J. MORRISON series = 2002 (his own shape drawings). Grading (Roman-gods ladder): Venere 2 Punti (top straight grain/birdseye) > Venere > Mercurio > Marte (+ Marte Sabbiata) > Terra Sabbiata > Giove > Plutone > Tabacco (sculpted leaves) > Meteora (scale rustication, house signature) > Urano (sabbiata/roccia) > Nettuno > Goccia. Briar air-cured ~10 years (Monjure-era claim); fantasy series w/ silver + colored acrylic.

brand_marks.physical: ARDOR + grade name (Roman gods) + finish; Meteora scale-rustication = house signature; colored methacrylate stems = Damiano era (later years).

line_years._notes: j. morrison: series born 2002 (Morrison's own account). super giants: after the Giants line was established (Morrison timeline, ~2000s) -> floor 2003 approx LOW. 'giants' NOT encoded as a bare key (the word appears descriptively too often); grade names (Venere...) span the brand -> unencoded.

table.label: ARDOR brand floor = 1974 (pre-1974 Rovera pipes = Sociedade Rovera / Rovera marks, mid-grade production)
COLOURED methacrylate stems = the Damiano era (introduction year undocumented -> approx floor 1995, LOW)
